research.title: Calibration Evaluation for Regularized Binary Classifiers
bullets: Implemented assigned routines for fitting regularized logistic regression models and generating reliability diagrams using predefined training and validation splits.
Computed Brier scores and calibration summaries across specified regularization settings, checking evaluation code against reference calculations supplied by the group.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Processing
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded inventory discrepancies, and forwarded missing or damaged item reports to the appropriate staff.
Organized order paperwork, updated fulfillment logs, and coordinated routine pickup arrangements while maintaining records of pending requests and completed handoffs.

projects.title: Baseline Regression for Residential Energy Demand
bullets: Implemented ordinary least squares and ridge regression baselines to predict residential energy demand from weather measurements and calendar features.
Applied training-set standardization, selected ridge penalties using cross-validation, and compared held-out prediction errors with a mean-demand baseline.
